title: Pasulka's Encounters source: daughter of a man thought to be in a secret space program who kept saying 'simulacra'
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Pasulka's Encounters source: daughter of a man thought to be in a secret space program who kept saying 'simulacra', about unspecified (book published 2023) at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Pasulka's source in her new book Encounters was the daughter of somebody who she thought was in a secret space program. One thing that will always give me the chills from that account is that her father would constantly refer to the word simulacra at lunch tables with his colleagues.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that one source in Encounters, a 2023 book by the religion professor Diana Pasulka, was the daughter of a man Pasulka believed worked in a secret space programme. According to the daughter, her father kept using the word "simulacra," meaning copies or imitations, at lunch with his colleagues, a detail Michels says gives him chills. If true, it would hint that insiders think our reality may be some kind of copy or simulation.
